description: 경상북도 청도군_재난대피소 [evacuation shelters and public facilities and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경상북도 청도군. 경상북도 청도군 내에서 각종 재난 상황 발생 시 주민들이 안전하게 대피할 수 있도록 지정된 재난대피소에 대한 정보를 제공합니다. Coverage: 경상북도 청도군. The portal files it under the publisher 경상북도 청도군. Its tags are 재난안전, 대피장소, 임시주거시설, 수용가능인원, 안전취약지역. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-09-08 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
